Legal & Transparency

Privacy Policy

We respect your privacy and believe in being completely clear about how we collect, use, and protect your information.

Last Updated: October 2026

Quick Summary

  • ✓ We only collect data required to serve you or respond to your enquiries.
  • ✓ We never sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
  • ✓ You can request deletion or correction of your data at any time.
  • ✓ All communication is handled securely.

Have Questions?

For any questions regarding these Privacy Policy, Write to our team directly:

hello@greviadigital.com

1. Who We Are

Welcome to Grevia Digital ("we," "our," or "us"). We are a digital marketing, website design, and search engine optimization (SEO) agency based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India.

This Privacy Policy explains in simple terms how we handle your personal information when you visit our website (greviadigital.com), submit contact or project enquiry forms, or partner with us for marketing and web development services.

2. Information We Collect

We only collect information that is genuinely necessary to deliver our services and communicate effectively with you:

Information You Give Us Directly

When you submit an enquiry, project request, or contact form, you may provide your name, email address, phone/WhatsApp number, company name, website URL, and details about your project requirements.

Technical & Browsing Data

When you browse our website, our analytics tools may automatically record standard browser data such as your IP address, device type, browser version, pages visited, time spent, and referral sources.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for specific, legitimate business purposes:

  • To respond to your enquiries: Evaluating your project needs, calculating quotations, and answering your questions.
  • To deliver contracted services: Building your website, managing your SEO campaigns, running ad campaigns, and providing regular progress reports.
  • To improve our website: Understanding how visitors interact with our content so we can make our pages faster, more useful, and easier to navigate.
  • To send important updates: Notifying you about milestones, invoices, security updates, or policy changes directly related to your project.

Note: We do not send spam. We will only contact you regarding genuine business discussions, project updates, or services you have specifically enquired about.

4. Sharing Your Information

We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information to data brokers or third-party advertisers. Ever.

We may share your data only in the following limited situations:

  • Trusted Service Providers: Secure third-party platforms that help us operate our agency (such as email delivery tools, web hosting providers, analytics tools like Google Analytics, and payment processors). These providers are strictly bound to protect your data.
  • Ad & Search Platforms (with your consent): When you hire us to manage paid ad campaigns, campaign account data is set up on official platforms like Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager.
  • Legal Requirements: If required by Indian law, court order, or governmental authorities to comply with applicable legal obligations.

5. Cookies and Tracking

Cookies are small text files placed on your device to help the website run smoothly and measure traffic. We use cookies to:

  • Remember your preferences during your visit.
  • Analyze website performance and visitor traffic through tools like Google Analytics.
  • Ensure our contact and enquiry forms load quickly and prevent spam submissions.

You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings at any time without losing access to the main content of our website.

6. Data Security

We take the security of your information seriously. Our website uses modern SSL/TLS encryption (HTTPS) to protect data in transit. Access to client project files, credentials, and sensitive assets is restricted to authorized team members on a strict need-to-know basis.

While no internet transmission is 100% immune from risks, we follow industry best practices to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

7. Your Rights Over Your Data

You have full control over your personal information. At any time, you can ask us to:

  • Give you a copy of the personal details we have on file for you.
  • Update or correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Delete your personal details from our active records.
  • Stop sending you any non-essential promotional messages.

To exercise any of these rights, simply email us at hello@greviadigital.com. We respond to all requests promptly.

8. Links to Other Websites

Our website or blog posts may contain links to external websites, articles, or tools. We do not control and are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of third-party websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies when visiting them.

9. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our agency operations or applicable legal requirements. The latest version will always be published on this page with the updated date at the top.
